newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU condemns murder of aid workers in Chechnya.
newsitem.headline: EU condemns murder of aid workers in Chechnya.

text.p: The European Union on Wednesday condemned the murder in Chechnya of six aid workers of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC).
"This is a most heinous crime, the more so in view of the humanitanian nature of the work in which the victims were engaged," EU president Ireland said in a statement on behalf of the 15-nation bloc.
The presidency called on the authorities to make every effort to bring the perpetrators to justice urgently.
"It is essential that the safety and security of humanitarian aid workers on the ground in Chechnya is guaranteed, and that they are facilitated in carrying our their work unhindered," the EU said.
The workers, five women and one man, were shot dead on Tuesday by a masked gunman as they were sleeping in a Red Cross hospital compound in the village of Novye Atagi.
The EU said the killings should not be allowed to derail efforts to achieve a negotiated settlement to the conflict in Chechnya.
